info.name: Vimeo Player Diagnostic
info.description: Diagnostic request for comparing Postman/Newman behavior with Python clients. The collection intentionally does not hard-code temporary Cloudflare cookies.

request.description: The Cookie header is intentionally omitted. Newman/Postman will use the active Cookie Jar and persist Set-Cookie values for the run.

exec: const status = typeof response.code === 'number' ? response.code : null;
const challenge = /cloudflare|turnstile|couldn't verify|checking if the site connection is secure/i.test(body);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ status, contentType, server, cfRay, bodyLength: body.length, cloudflareChallenge: challenge }));
pm.test('HTTP response received', function () { pm.expect(status, 'No HTTP response; inspect Newman request error').to.not.eql(null); });
if (status !== null) { pm.test('Response body is not a Cloudflare challenge', function () { pm.expect(challenge, 'Cloudflare challenge detected').to.eql(false); }); }
